scope: Isolated node:http loopback client and server in one process, without gate, authentication, fixture, fetch override, or Date.now override

evidence.implication: Pacing avoids refusal but only 34 sockets, so this does not prove 300 simultaneous connections

evidence.mode: Establish 300 sockets in groups of 10 with 2ms pacing while withholding all responses, then release and reuse

conclusion: Failure is reproducible during a burst of new TCP connection establishment outside gate/auth code. Established connection capacity and HTTP concurrency of 300 are demonstrated to work. The exact rejecting Windows/Node/network component is not identified.
pending: Need lower-level socket/ETW or packet evidence to distinguish listen acceptance/backlog behavior from network filtering or another local TCP implementation constraint. backlog=2048 alone did not prevent refusal.
benchmarkRecommendation: Use paced pre-establishment of 300 keep-alive sockets before timing 300 request concurrency; record connection priming separately. Do not reduce the claimed concurrency to 30.
exclusions: No relation to previous T10 failure established
interruptedAttempt: First held-response test omitted release for requests arriving after flush and was interrupted. Corrected bounded diagnostic waits for held+errors before release.
